verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is self-hosted and can run fully air-gapped/offline, which inherently lets users choose data residency by controlling the deployment location themselves (docs-18, docs-20, gh-1). However, there is no explicit region/residency selection feature, no multi-region hosting options, and no documented data-residency controls for cloud-connected components (e.g., web search or external API calls). missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration UI or docs, guidance on data locality when using external model/API providers, independent confirmation of residency compliance.
